task_text: I have a video call starting in 5 minutes. My desk area needs to look presentable and I should be able to see and hear clearly. The bedroom light is off.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare any light objects in the living room that need to be passed to R2 for the bedroom.
central_instructions.R2: Move to the bedroom to receive any necessary items from R1 and assist R3 in making the desk area presentable.
central_instructions.R3: Organize and tidy up the desk area in the bedroom to ensure it looks presentable for the video call.
central_instructions.R4: Turn on the bedroom light and assist R3 by moving any heavy objects if needed to make the desk area presentable.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Identify any light objects in the living room that need to be passed to R2 for the bedroom. (r1_s1)
- R2 [ASK_HELP] Move to the living room to receive objects from R1. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Hand over identified light objects to R2. (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Collect light objects from R1 for the bedroom. (r2_s2)
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the bedroom to place the objects. (r2_s3)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the bedroom to meet R1 and R3. (r2_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Gather necessary items to pass to R2. (r1_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Start organizing the desk area. (r3_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Hand over necessary items to R2. (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive items from R1. (r2_s2)
- R2 [HELP] Assist R3 in making the desk area presentable with received items. (r2_s3)
- R3 [HELP] Continue organizing the desk area with R2's assistance. (r3_s2)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Turn on the desk lamp to improve lighting. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Arrange the notebook and pen neatly on the desk. (r3_s2)
- R3 [LOCAL] Move the phone to the side to clear space. (r3_s3)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure the laptop is open and positioned correctly for the video call. (r3_s4)
- R3 [LOCAL] Adjust the position of the monitors for optimal viewing. (r3_s5)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Turn on the bedroom light. (r4_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Organize small items on the desk to make it look tidy. (r3_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [ASK_HELP] Request R4 to move the chair to a better position for the video call. (r3_s2)
- R4 [HELP] Move the chair to a suitable position for the video call. (r4_s2)
- R3 [LOCAL] Adjust the position of the laptop for optimal camera angle. (r3_s3)
